title: Medusa: Simple LLM Inference Acceleration Framework with Multiple Decoding Heads
layout_note: Tree on the left feeding an attention-mask matrix on the right; tree rows double as the matrix's row labels.
grouping: Left: a candidate-token tree whose levels sit in rounded tinted containers (red 'Head 1'; orange 'Head 2' holding a yellow and a green sub-group). Right: a square attention-mask grid whose column header row ('Key') is boxed in the same red, yellow and green tints. The query tokens of the tree line up row for row with the grid rows.
shapes_depth: Tokens are white circles with a thin outline holding one word; a grey 'Root' circle starts the tree and right-angled black arrows branch to the children. The mask is a plain grid of empty white cells with purple hand-drawn-style check marks where attention is allowed. A bold 'Tree Mask' label with a small tree icon sits bottom-left.
proposed_highlight: No proposed/baseline contrast; the head colours carry through tree and mask, so the reader can trace each tick to a path in the tree.
lesson: Align the candidate-token tree row for row with the attention-mask grid and colour the grid's key header with the same per-head tints as the tree, so each allowed cell can be traced back to a tree path.
notes: Venue as for figure 1 (PDF footer, ICML 2024).

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

taxonomy.task: tree attention for verifying candidate continuations

core.what: a token tree on the left (Root, Head 1's two tokens, Head 2's three tokens under each) is laid against an 8 x 8 attention grid whose query rows are the tree's nodes and whose tinted key header repeats the same token groups, so the check marks trace the tree's ancestor paths

relations.form: the mask is drawn as a literal 8 x 8 grid of empty cells with purple check marks where a query may attend a key, the checks forming the tree's root-to-leaf paths

elbow lines from each tree node run right so every query token sits level with its grid row, while the same tokens appear as the column header across the top in matching tinted boxes (pink 'It, I', yellow and green 'is, ', the')
the tree branches downward from the grey Root through the pink Head 1 container into the orange Head 2 container, which holds two sub-groups (yellow, green), one per Head 1 token

channels.colour: container tint = which head / which parent's branch a token belongs to (pink Head 1; orange Head 2 with yellow and green sub-groups), repeated on the key header; purple = an allowed attention entry
channels.shape: circles = tokens; grid cells = query-key pairs; check mark = allowed attention
channels.line: solid elbow arrows = tree edges and row alignment at once
channels.frame: rounded tinted box = one head's candidate set or one branch's sub-group

quality.strengths: the mask is explained by placing its two sources against it: tree nodes are the rows and the same tinted token groups are the columns, so the block pattern of checks reads as the tree's ancestry without a formula; tokens are real words
quality.weaknesses: the tree edges double as row-alignment wires, so long elbow lines from Head 1 tokens snake down past the Head 2 container; the orange Head 2 tint in the tree does not appear in the key header (only its yellow and green sub-groups do); the big 'Tree Mask' title with an emoji sits at the lower left far from the grid

insights.structure: A token tree on the left (grey Root, a pink 'Head 1' container with 'It', 'I', an orange 'Head 2' container with two sub-groups of 'is, ', the') and an 8 x 8 attention grid on the right whose column header is the same tokens grouped in the same tinted boxes.
insights.data: Tokens are circles with the word inside; the mask is a grid of empty cells with purple check marks where a query may attend to a key.
insights.emphasis: Colour-matched groups: each head's tint (pink, yellow, green) is repeated in the key header above the grid, so the block structure of the check marks reads as the tree.
insights.flow: The tree branches downward from Root with elbow lines that run right into the grid rows, so each query token on the left lines up with its row; keys read across the top.
insights.avoid: The 'Tree Mask' title with a tree emoji sits at lower left in large bold type, far from the grid it names.

arrangement.units: an unframed token tree with tinted per-head containers on the left and an unframed attention grid on the right
arrangement.shared: the same token groups and tints appear in both the tree and the grid header
